layers.prompt: A wide panoramic side-scrolling game BACKGROUND (landscape, about 3:1): an underwater coral kingdom — glowing coral reefs, a sunken red pagoda covered in seaweed, sun rays shining down through turquoise water, bubbles and small fish silhouettes. No characters, no text, no UI. The LEFT and RIGHT edges must match so the image tiles seamlessly horizontally. Keep the lower third calm and simple because game characters stand there.

A long horizontal game GROUND STRIP (landscape, about 6:1) on a TRANSPARENT background: a sandy sea floor with pink and orange coral, green seaweed and shells, with a front edge of rounded rocks. Side view, flat top edge where characters stand. No characters, no text. Left and right edges must tile seamlessly.
